firm_data.firm_description: Ouimette, Goldstein & Andrews, LLP is a law firm serving the Hudson Valley and New York State, focusing on Social Security Disability and Workers' Compensation law. They have over 45 years of experience representing injured workers.
notable_facts: They have multiple office locations including Poughkeepsie, Middletown, New Windsor, and Suffern.
The firm's attorneys cover hearings for residents of Rockland, Dutchess, Orange, Westchester, Ulster, and Sullivan Counties.

email.subject: AI for Ouimette, Goldstein, & Andrews, LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Scott,

With 45+ years representing injured workers across the Hudson Valley, you've built something most firms can't: deep expertise in Social Security Disability and Workers' Compensation that BigLaw simply doesn't match. That advantage is exactly what we're built to protect.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform made for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding regionally. I'd love to stop by your Poughkeepsie office to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete without compromising what makes them strong.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
